meta.source: Primer Web (Figma, github/primer) structure with Sleepy Cat's Catppuccin Latte and Mocha palette

tokens.name: bgColor-default
tokens.usage: Page canvas and the fill of cards, boxes, inputs and menus. Lavender-warm, never pure grey. fgColor-default reads 7.8:1 on it in Latte, 11.3:1 in Mocha.

tokens.name: bgColor-muted
tokens.usage: Box headers, table header rows, sidebars, the SegmentedControl track and hover fills on rows. One step off bgColor-default.

tokens.name: bgColor-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed regions: the area behind a Dialog body, code blocks, the page behind a centred column.

tokens.name: bgColor-emphasis
tokens.usage: Inverse surfaces: tooltips and the dark counter. Pair with fgColor-onEmphasis.

tokens.name: bgColor-disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled inputs and buttons. Pair with fgColor-disabled.

tokens.name: bgColor-neutral-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary CounterLabel, the neutral Chip, avatar fallback fill.

tokens.name: bgColor-neutral-emphasis
tokens.usage: Primary CounterLabel and the closed-neutral StateLabel. Pair with fgColor-onEmphasis.

tokens.name: bgColor-accent-muted
tokens.usage: Mauve wash: the selected ActionList item, the accent Chip, the info-free brand Banner (upsell). fgColor-accent on it reads 5.4:1 (Latte).

tokens.name: bgColor-accent-emphasis
tokens.usage: Solid mauve: the selected SegmentedControl indicator in dark, the toggle track when on, checked checkbox and radio, the ActionList active bar.

tokens.name: bgColor-success-muted
tokens.usage: Success Banner and Chip fill. Pair with fgColor-success.

tokens.name: bgColor-success-emphasis
tokens.usage: Open StateLabel and solid success marks. Pair with fgColor-onEmphasis.

tokens.name: bgColor-attention-muted
tokens.usage: Warning Banner and Chip fill. Pair with fgColor-attention.

tokens.name: bgColor-attention-emphasis
tokens.usage: Solid attention marks. Pair with fgColor-onEmphasis.

tokens.name: bgColor-severe-muted
tokens.usage: Severe Chip fill (peach). Pair with fgColor-severe.

tokens.name: bgColor-severe-emphasis
tokens.usage: Solid severe marks (peach). Pair with fgColor-onEmphasis.

tokens.name: bgColor-danger-muted
tokens.usage: Critical Banner, danger Chip and the hover fill of a danger button. Pair with fgColor-danger.

tokens.name: bgColor-danger-emphasis
tokens.usage: Closed StateLabel, solid danger button on hover, error marks. Pair with fgColor-onEmphasis.

tokens.name: bgColor-done-muted
tokens.usage: Done Chip fill (plum pink). Pair with fgColor-done.

tokens.name: bgColor-done-emphasis
tokens.usage: Merged or done StateLabel. Pair with fgColor-onEmphasis.

tokens.name: bgColor-info-muted
tokens.usage: Info Banner and Chip fill (sapphire). Pair with fgColor-info.

tokens.name: bgColor-info-emphasis
tokens.usage: Solid info marks. Pair with fgColor-onEmphasis.

tokens.name: fgColor-default
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and control labels on bgColor-default, bgColor-muted, bgColor-inset and bgColor-neutral-muted (at least 6.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: fgColor-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata and neutral icons on bgColor-default, bgColor-muted and bgColor-inset (at least 5.5:1 in Latte, 6.7:1 in Mocha).

tokens.name: fgColor-onEmphasis
tokens.usage: Text and icons on every *-emphasis fill, the primary button and bgColor-emphasis. White in Latte, crust in Mocha because Mocha's fills are pastel.

tokens.name: fgColor-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholder-like hints. Exempt from contrast; never use it for content that must be read.

tokens.name: fgColor-accent
tokens.usage: Mauve text: links, the selected UnderlineNav item label, accent Chip and Label text. Darker than bgColor-accent-emphasis so it reads 6.2:1 on bgColor-default in Latte.

tokens.name: fgColor-success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on bgColor-default, bgColor-muted and bgColor-success-muted.

tokens.name: fgColor-attention
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on bgColor-default and bgColor-attention-muted.

tokens.name: fgColor-severe
tokens.usage: Severe (peach) text and icons on bgColor-default and bgColor-severe-muted.

tokens.name: fgColor-danger
tokens.usage: Error text, validation messages, danger button label and icons on bgColor-default, bgColor-danger-muted and button-default-bgColor-rest.

tokens.name: fgColor-done
tokens.usage: Done (plum pink) text and icons on bgColor-default and bgColor-done-muted.

tokens.name: fgColor-info
tokens.usage: Info (sapphire) text and icons on bgColor-default and bgColor-info-muted.

tokens.name: fgColor-link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Same mauve as fgColor-accent; hover underlines, never changes hue.

tokens.name: borderColor-default
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline: boxes, cards, dialogs, menus, table rows, button borders. Decorative, so it sits under 3:1 by design; never the only cue for a control boundary (inputs use control-borderColor-rest).

tokens.name: borderColor-muted
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a box: list rows, Timeline gaps, header underlines.

tokens.name: borderColor-emphasis
tokens.usage: A hairline that must be seen: the selected UnderlineNav underline track, separators that carry meaning. At least 3:1 on bgColor-default.

tokens.name: borderColor-accent-emphasis
tokens.usage: Accent outlines: the accent Label border, selected card outline.

tokens.name: borderColor-success-emphasis
tokens.usage: Success Label border and Banner icon ring.

tokens.name: borderColor-attention-emphasis
tokens.usage: Attention Label border.

tokens.name: borderColor-danger-emphasis
tokens.usage: Invalid input border and danger Label border.

tokens.name: borderColor-done-emphasis
tokens.usage: Done Label border.

tokens.name: borderColor-info-emphasis
tokens.usage: Info Label border.

tokens.name: focus-outlineColor
tokens.usage: The focus ring: a 2px solid outline at 2px offset on every focusable element. Mauve, at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: button-default-bgColor-rest
tokens.usage: Default (secondary) Button fill.

tokens.name: button-default-bgColor-hover
tokens.usage: Default Button hover fill; also IconButton hover.

tokens.name: button-default-bgColor-active
tokens.usage: Default Button pressed fill.

tokens.name: button-default-borderColor-rest
tokens.usage: Default Button border.

tokens.name: button-primary-bgColor-rest
tokens.usage: Primary Button fill: one per view. Label is fgColor-onEmphasis (5.4:1 Latte, 9.2:1 Mocha).

tokens.name: button-primary-bgColor-hover
tokens.usage: Primary Button hover fill.

tokens.name: button-primary-bgColor-active
tokens.usage: Primary Button pressed fill.

tokens.name: control-bgColor-rest
tokens.usage: Fill of TextInput, Textarea and Select.

tokens.name: control-borderColor-rest
tokens.usage: Border of TextInput, Textarea, Select, Checkbox and Radio at rest: at least 3:1 so the control boundary is visible.

tokens.name: control-transparent-bgColor-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for invisible buttons, ActionList items and UnderlineNav items.

tokens.name: control-transparent-bgColor-selected
tokens.usage: Selected fill for ActionList and NavList items without an accent.

tokens.name: controlTrack-bgColor-rest
tokens.usage: Toggle track when off and the SegmentedControl track.

tokens.name: controlKnob-bgColor-rest
tokens.usage: Toggle handle and the selected SegmentedControl button.

tokens.name: overlay-bgColor
tokens.usage: Fill of Dialog, ActionMenu and other floating overlays.

tokens.name: overlay-backdrop-bgColor
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a modal Dialog: soft, never opaque.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page ground, an alias of bgColor-default. The design system page paints component previews on this token; use bgColor-default in your own code.

families.sans: "Mona Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.heading: "Quicksand", "Mona Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Mona Sans Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.numeric: "JetBrains Mono", "Mona Sans Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and empty-state headlines only. Quicksand 600, never 700.

styles.name: text-title-small
styles.usage: Box headers, card titles, Banner titles.

styles.name: text-body-large
styles.sample: We saved your draft. Pick it up whenever you like.

styles.name: text-body-medium
styles.usage: The default UI text: list rows, inputs, buttons (at 600), menus.

styles.name: text-body-small
styles.usage: Metadata, captions, Label and Counter text (at 600).

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Form captions and hints under a field, in fgColor-muted.

styles.name: text-script
styles.usage: A single handwritten greeting or one word in a hero. Never body copy, labels or anything under 16px.

styles.name: text-stat-large
styles.usage: Hero figures: the one headline number on a dashboard or landing section. CountUp sets its digits in this family.

styles.name: text-stat
styles.usage: Stat tiles and KPI rows, usually under a text-body-small muted label.

styles.name: text-stat-small
styles.usage: Inline figures in cards and table summaries.

tokens.name: base-size-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: Counter inner offset, focus outline offset.

tokens.name: base-size-4
tokens.usage: Base step of the 4px grid; icon-to-text gap in small controls, SegmentedControl track padding.

tokens.name: base-size-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a control's icon and label; condensed stack gap.

tokens.name: base-size-12
tokens.usage: Inline padding of medium buttons and inputs; ActionList item padding.

tokens.name: base-size-16
tokens.usage: Box padding and the normal stack gap.

tokens.name: base-size-20
tokens.usage: Banner padding block, Dialog header padding.

tokens.name: base-size-24
tokens.usage: Spacious stack gap and card padding on roomy layouts.

tokens.name: base-size-32
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: base-size-40
tokens.usage: Large section spacing.

tokens.name: base-size-48
tokens.usage: Page header vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: base-size-64
tokens.usage: Empty-state (Blankslate) padding.

tokens.name: base-size-96
tokens.usage: Marketing hero breathing room.

tokens.name: stack-gap-condensed
tokens.usage: Gap between tightly related items: chips in a row, buttons in a group.

tokens.name: stack-gap-normal
tokens.usage: Default gap between sibling elements.

tokens.name: stack-gap-spacious
tokens.usage: Gap between groups of content.

tokens.name: stack-padding-condensed
tokens.usage: Padding of dense boxes and menus.

tokens.name: stack-padding-normal
tokens.usage: Default padding inside boxes and cards.

tokens.name: stack-padding-spacious
tokens.usage: Padding of hero cards and Dialog bodies on wide screens.

tokens.name: control-medium-paddingInline-normal
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of medium buttons and inputs (Primer value).

tokens.name: control-medium-paddingBlock
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of medium buttons (Primer value).

tokens.name: control-medium-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label inside a medium control (Primer value).

tokens.name: borderRadius-small
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, inline code, the selected SegmentedControl button inside its track, square avatars at 24px and under, tooltips. Primer uses 3px.

tokens.name: borderRadius-medium
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, Select, Textarea, ActionList items, the SegmentedControl track, the Toggle track (its handle nests 2px inside at 8px). Primer uses 6px; Purrimer softens it to 10px.

tokens.name: borderRadius-large
tokens.usage: Boxes and cards, Banner, ActionMenu overlay, Dialog. Primer uses 12px.

tokens.name: borderRadius-xlarge
tokens.usage: Featured and hero cards only.

tokens.name: borderRadius-full
tokens.usage: Labels, Chips, StateLabel, CounterLabel, people's avatars.

size.note: Control heights from Primer's control scale.

tokens.name: control-xsmall-size
tokens.usage: Extra-small controls: compact IconButtons inside rows.

tokens.name: control-small-size
tokens.usage: Small Button, small SegmentedControl, small TextInput.

tokens.name: control-medium-size
tokens.usage: The default control height: Button, TextInput, Select, SegmentedControl, ActionList item.

tokens.name: control-large-size
tokens.usage: Large Button and TextInput; UnderlineNav items sit in a 48px bar.

tokens.name: control-xlarge-size
tokens.usage: Extra-large touch targets and the UnderlineNav bar height.

tokens.name: borderWidth-thin
tokens.usage: Every hairline border.

tokens.name: borderWidth-thick
tokens.usage: Focus outline width and the selected UnderlineNav underline.

shadow.note: Hairline plus soft lift: every raised surface keeps its borderColor-default hairline and adds a faint mauve-tinted shadow. Neutral and deeper in Mocha; pure neutral black in both Noir themes.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Inputs, Textarea and Select at rest (Primer's inset).

tokens.name: shadow-resting-xsmall
tokens.usage: Default and primary buttons, the selected SegmentedControl button.

tokens.name: shadow-resting-small
tokens.usage: Cards and boxes: the soft lift under the hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-resting-medium
tokens.usage: Card hover and featured cards.

tokens.name: shadow-floating-small
tokens.usage: ActionMenu overlays, Select menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-floating-large
tokens.usage: Dialog.

duration.note: Two motion kinds share one chrome scale. Sleepy is the default everywhere and drifts slowly; playful is opted into for moments and springs quickly. Exits are always shorter than entrances.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Chrome, both kinds: hover and press fills, colour and border changes on every control.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Chrome, both kinds: overlays and menus opening, the Toggle handle, Checkbox marks.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Chrome, both kinds: Dialogs and page-level transitions when no motion kind is chosen.

tokens.name: duration-sleepy-short
tokens.usage: Sleepy entrances of small things: Chips, Labels, icons, counters, check marks.

tokens.name: duration-sleepy-medium
tokens.usage: The default sleepy entrance: cards, Banners, list rows, toasts, Dialogs.

tokens.name: duration-sleepy-long
tokens.usage: Sleepy page reveals, hero moments, large layout changes and count-ups.

tokens.name: duration-sleepy-exit
tokens.usage: Every sleepy exit. Things leave faster than they arrive.

tokens.name: duration-sleepy-attention
tokens.usage: One cycle of a sleepy attention motion: ear-twitch, tail-swish, slow-blink, hiss.

tokens.name: duration-sleepy-loop
tokens.usage: One breath of a sleepy ambient loop: breathe, daydream, firefly, skeleton snore.

tokens.name: duration-sleepy-loop-long
tokens.usage: Slow sleepy loops that travel: meander, hammock, moth, turn-around.

tokens.name: duration-sleepy-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings in a sleepy Stagger, letter or word reveal.

tokens.name: duration-playful-short
tokens.usage: Playful entrances of small things; long enough for the spring to settle.

tokens.name: duration-playful-medium
tokens.usage: The default playful entrance: success cards, empty states, celebration Dialogs.

tokens.name: duration-playful-long
tokens.usage: Playful hero entrances, bouncy landings, count-ups that overshoot.

tokens.name: duration-playful-exit
tokens.usage: Every playful exit, with a small anticipation before leaving.

tokens.name: duration-playful-attention
tokens.usage: One cycle of a playful attention motion; playful repeats it twice.

tokens.name: duration-playful-loop
tokens.usage: One beat of a playful ambient loop: breathe, daydream, paw-steps.

tokens.name: duration-playful-loop-long
tokens.usage: Playful loops that travel: meander, hammock, moth, yarn-roll.

tokens.name: duration-playful-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings in a playful Stagger, letter or word reveal.

tokens.name: duration-playful-press
tokens.usage: Playful press and check micro-interactions on Button, Checkbox, Radio and Toggle.

tokens.name: duration-reduced
tokens.usage: The fade that replaces movement for sleepy motion under prefers-reduced-motion.

easing.note: Sleepy curves never overshoot. Playful curves spring past the target and settle. easing-standard stays the chrome curve for hover, press and fills.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Chrome, both kinds: hover, press, colour changes, the Toggle handle when no kind is set.

tokens.name: easing-linear
tokens.usage: Constant motion only: Spinner rotation, sunbeam shimmer, indeterminate progress, View Transition crossfades.

tokens.name: easing-sleepy-enter
tokens.usage: Sleepy entrances: a long, soft deceleration that drifts into place with no overshoot.

tokens.name: easing-sleepy-exit
tokens.usage: Sleepy exits: a lazy acceleration away, no anticipation.

tokens.name: easing-sleepy-move
tokens.usage: Sleepy position changes that start and end at rest: reorder, collapse, tab panels, sheets.

tokens.name: easing-sleepy-drift
tokens.usage: Sleepy loops and attention motions: a sine-like breath in and out.

tokens.name: easing-playful-spring
tokens.usage: Playful entrances and moves: a spring that overshoots about 12% and settles. The default playful curve.

tokens.name: easing-playful-bounce
tokens.usage: Bigger playful moments: pounce, land, celebration Dialogs. Overshoots about 27% and wobbles twice.

tokens.name: easing-playful-pop
tokens.usage: Small playful pops that must finish quickly: Checkbox and Radio marks, counter bumps, Chips.

tokens.name: easing-playful-exit
tokens.usage: Playful exits: winds back slightly, then leaves. The anticipation of a cat about to jump.

tokens.name: easing-playful-fall
tokens.usage: Playful falls under gravity: the drop before land squashes on contact, confetti coming down.

tokens.name: easing-playful-snap
tokens.usage: Playful loops and attention motions: a quick snap into each keyframe.
